subject: Request for authoritative SOC 2 package and bridge — audit window provenance
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@medixhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medixhealth.com>, Medix Health Security <security@medixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for current SOC 2 artifacts — our copy appears expired

Hi Sofia,

Hope you are well. We're finalizing the security questionnaire for an upcoming procurement review and noticed the SOC 2 package we have on file ("redwood_soc2_2025_type2.pdf") shows an audit period ending 10/31/2025. Procurement flagged this as "expired" for their acceptance matrix.

Could you please confirm whether there is a newer Type II report or an official bridge letter available that covers the gap into 2026/2027? If there is a reissued file or a consolidated package, we need the authoritative filename, the audit window dates (start/end), and any short note we can add to our questionnaire explaining provenance.

Our target for procurement signoff is next Friday (5/28). If a short attestation or a redwood-signed bridge helps, we can accept that as interim evidence.

Thanks — really appreciate a quick confirmation so we can keep the timeline.

Best,
Alice Turner
Security Analyst
Medix Health

Attachments: (none in initial e-mail)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for current SOC 2 artifacts — our copy appears expired

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads-up and sorry for the confusion.

Looping in Karthik and Ben from Security/Compliance to confirm the authoritative package and the bridge status. I can send the files once we have the official filenames and a one-paragraph provenance note for your questionnaire.

Quick questions for your team to help us prioritize: 1) Will procurement accept a signed bridge letter + the most recent Type II PDF? 2) Do you need the evidence index CSV or just the cover report and bridge?

Tentative next steps from our side: Karthik will confirm which PDF is the canonical Type II and whether there was a reissue with a different bundle id; Ben will confirm whether we should include the evidence index. I will then send a single email back to you with: the PDF, the bridge letter, brief provenance language, and a secure download link.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Manager, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (internal checklist: soc2_request_tracker.xlsx — not included)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for current SOC 2 artifacts — our copy appears expired

Sofia / Ben — quick summary from compliance side:

- Authoritative report: redwood_soc2_type2_2026_final.pdf (final Type II issued by ClearSight LLP; report generation date 2027-01-15).
- Audit window covered in that package: 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31. The filename for the package does not include the audit window, which has caused confusion with older "2025"-titled PDFs in some customer folders.
- We also created a bridge letter dated 2027-01-15 titled soc2_bridge_20270115.pdf that clarifies the continuity from the prior package and notes that no control regressions were identified. That bridge is intended for procurement teams to accept when the latest audit report generation date falls outside the required acceptance window.
- Evidence index: evidence_index_2026.csv — contains pointers to artifacts (logs, policy versions). We can provide a redacted index if customers request it.

Notes for Sofia: the reissue you saw is likely our early "internal bundle" (redwood_soc2_2026_bundle_v1.pdf) which we do not circulate externally. The externally authoritative package is the final PDF above plus the bridge. We should send both and a short provenance paragraph.

Suggested provenance blurb (short): "Redwood Inference's authoritative SOC 2 Type II package for the audit period 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31 is provided as "redwood_soc2_type2_2026_final.pdf" (issued 2027-01-15). A signed bridge letter ("soc2_bridge_20270115.pdf") is included to clarify continuity from the prior reporting period."

I can host the files on a secure link (S3 pre-signed) for Medix to download. Would you like us to request Procurement to confirm acceptance now or wait for a formal PO?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_2026_final.pdf (attachment stub), soc2_bridge_20270115.pdf (attachment stub), evidence_index_2026.csv (attachment stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medixhealth.com>, Medix Health Security <security@medixhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for current SOC 2 artifacts — our copy appears expired

Hi Alice — thanks for flagging this. Attached are the authoritative artifacts and a short provenance note for your questionnaire.

Deliverables (attached / links):
- redwood_soc2_type2_2026_final.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report; audit window: 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31; issued 2027-01-15)
- soc2_bridge_20270115.pdf (signed bridge clarifying continuity and noting no control regressions)
- evidence_index_2026.csv (redacted index; contains artifact references — let us know if you need additional evidence)

Provenance language for your questionnaire (copy/paste):
"Redwood Inference's authoritative SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31 is provided as "redwood_soc2_type2_2026_final.pdf" (issued 2027-01-15). A signed bridge letter ("soc2_bridge_20270115.pdf") is included to explain continuity from the prior reporting period and to confirm no material control regressions were identified."

Secure download link (expires in 7 days): https://s3.redwood-inference.com/secure/medix/soc2/redwood_soc2_2026_final.pdf
Hub record for audit trail: https://hub.redwood-inference.com/records/HS-98765

If Procurement will accept the bridge + final PDF, this should satisfy the acceptance matrix. If they require additional attestation (e.g., on specific controls), let us know which controls and we will coordinate with our auditor to provide targeted language.

Next steps: if this works, confirm and we'll close the loop; if Procurement needs a different artifact naming convention, we can also provide a single cover letter that references both files for your PO.

Thanks — happy to hop on 15-minute call if helpful.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Manager, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
